comment: Parameter 30 is an unmarked button over the OSCiX lettering, the easter egg the manual hints at. Parameters 1, 2, 7 to 13 and 18, inputs 2, 8 and 9, and outputs 0 and 1 are declared in the code but are not placed on the panel, so they carry no line. The two linear FM inputs are exponential.
